snippet.title: Soccerwarz Trailer | 7v7 Soccer Strategy Game | Nov 18, 2026 · Android / iOS
snippet.description:
Place your players strategically and battle! Soccerwarz is a 7v7 soccer strategy game with fantasy characters.
Predict your opponent's strategy and place 7 players on a 5x9 pitch. Passes, steals, 1-on-1 duels and shots play out based on each player's stats. Reposition mid-match to turn the game around, and settle draws in a penalty shootout.

Launching worldwide on November 18, 2026 · Android / iOS · 11 languages
Website: https://soccer-warz.com
Contact: contact@soccer-warz.com

#Soccerwarz #soccergame #strategygame #mobilegame
